description: ELFLYSVE: Probability distributions for air traffic at Swedish airports is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by RISE. About This dataset was produced as part of the ELFLYSVE research project, which investigates the potential of electric aviation in Sweden. One of the project’s work packages focuses on techno-economic modeling and optimization of airport energy systems, specifically their design and sizing to meet the requirements for electric aircraft (EA) charging. Coverage: RISE. The publisher named on the listing is RISE. Its keywords include aviation, airport, air traffic. The listing shows 2026-01-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
